literal: This is the nature of Zhu and Jun; Yao and Shun could not instruct it.
idiomatic: Such was the nature of Zhu and Jun; Yao and Shun could not instruct it.

literal: Jingzhao early had fair renown; late he met overturn—accustomed to what stained him; can one not be cautious!
idiomatic: Jingzhao early won fair renown; late he met ruin—habit from what stained him. Can one not be cautious?

literal: Qinghe's capacity, insight, talent, and fame—as a close kinsman made counselor, when the bell of hardship tolled, he first met the wall-thorn's press.
idiomatic: Qinghe's capacity, insight, talent, and fame—as a close kinsman made counselor, when hardship tolled, he first met the wall-thorn's press.

literal: Fortune belonged to the Way's decline; late he was throttled in the hand of fierce power.
idiomatic: Fortune met the Way's decline; late he was throttled by fierce power.

literal: Guangping in early years was arrogant and full; Runan by nature tended to wild excess; judging beginning and end, both scarcely merit discussion.
idiomatic: Guangping in early years was arrogant and full; Runan by nature tended to wild excess; judged from beginning to end, both scarcely merit discussion.

literal: Yet Yue, abandoned by Heaven and men, in the end met the poison of suspicion and fear—surely the extreme of being pressed by the earth.
idiomatic: Yet Yue, abandoned by Heaven and men, in the end met the poison of suspicion and fear—surely the extreme of a prince pressed too near the throne.

literal: From the time Wei moved west, power shifted to the Zhou house.
idiomatic: From the time Wei moved west, power shifted to the Zhou house.

literal: Yet King Wen of Zhou was heaven-endowed, broad and kind, his nature rarely suspicious;
idiomatic: Yet King Wen of Zhou was heaven-endowed, broad and kind, rarely suspicious;

literal: the Yuan clan kin were all preserved; within and without they were employed and spread through the ranks of office.
idiomatic: the Yuan kin were all preserved and employed within and without across the ranks of office.

literal: When Xiaomin ascended, he did not replace the former thread; Mingwu continued the enterprise and also followed the former intent.
idiomatic: When Xiaomin ascended, he did not break the former thread; Mingwu continued the enterprise and followed the former intent.

literal: Though Heaven tired of Wei's virtue and the tripod mandate had shifted, branches and leaves flourished lush—enough to surpass the former age.
idiomatic: Though Heaven tired of Wei's virtue and the mandate had shifted, branches and leaves flourished enough to surpass the former age.
